name: unterm
description: The terminal AI agents can drive. Spawn, focus, split, and type into terminal panes from any MCP-speaking agent — 67 methods across 11 namespaces. Local-first (127.0.0.1 only, auth-token gated), per-call audit, $0, MIT.
tagline: Drive a real macOS / Linux / Windows terminal from any AI agent

transports.description: Recommended. The unterm-cli mcp-stdio bridge proxies to the local Unterm GUI's TCP server. Auto-discovers the running instance via ~/.unterm/active.json.

Direct TCP. Each Unterm window publishes its port + auth_token in ~/.unterm/active.json (single instance) and ~/.unterm/instances/<name>.json (multi-instance, NATO-named: alpha / bravo / charlie ...).

after_install: Open Unterm.app once so the MCP server boots and writes ~/.unterm/active.json.
Drop the mcp-stdio config snippet from marketplace/mcp/configs/<your-client>.json into your MCP client.
The client then has 67 methods to drive your terminal.

discovery.describe_method_description: Calling meta.surface returns the full live API (every method with its param schema, every CLI subcommand, every currently-bound keybinding) — the same JSON `unterm-cli reference` prints. Agents that just connected learn the entire surface in one round-trip without docs.

namespaces.name: session
namespaces.summary: Spawn, split, focus, resize, destroy panes; type into them; read cwd / history / idle state.

namespaces.name: screen
namespaces.summary: Live viewport text, full scrollback as a single string, cursor position, regex search, error detection.

namespaces.name: exec
namespaces.summary: Run, run_wait, send bytes, status, cancel, POSIX signal — structured results, no screen-scraping.

namespaces.name: capture
namespaces.summary: Screenshot screen / window / drag-selected region; read the clipboard.

namespaces.name: upload
namespaces.summary: Push a local file to your own object storage (Aliyun OSS / Tencent COS / Qiniu) and return a public URL.

namespaces.name: proxy
namespaces.summary: Read/switch OS proxy state, latency-test endpoints, apply/clear overrides.

namespaces.name: instance
namespaces.summary: Enumerate every live Unterm on the machine (NATO-named: alpha/bravo/charlie...), focus one, retitle, info.

namespaces.name: workspace
namespaces.summary: Save / list / restore the current window's full pane+tab layout.

namespaces.name: system
namespaces.summary: OS / arch / locale; launch with elevated privileges (Windows-only).

namespaces.name: governance
namespaces.summary: Audit log, policy check/set, agent.identify/whoami, self-test, server.health/info/capabilities.

namespaces.name: meta
namespaces.summary: meta.surface — one call returns every method + CLI subcommand + live keybinding (the self-describing surface).

security.auth: Bearer token written to ~/.unterm/active.json on launch (chmod 600). The mcp-stdio bridge reads it transparently; raw TCP clients send `{"method":"auth.login","params":{"token":"<value>"}}` first.
security.audit: Every session.input / exec.send is logged with the calling agent's identity. First write from a new agent triggers a blocking Allow / Block / Always-allow banner. Trust persists in ~/.unterm/trusted_agents.json and is one-click revocable from Web Settings.
security.telemetry: None. Zero outbound HTTP at runtime; everything stays on 127.0.0.1.
security.sandbox: FinderSync extension is app-sandboxed (Apple Developer ID signed + notarized). The main app is signed but not sandboxed (needs full file access to drive the terminal).
